pageDescription: Unified control panel for free shipping and flat rate shipping settings, with quick links to other discount tools.
loadingDescription: Preparing your modern control panel with existing data.
freeShippingDesc: When enabled, customers get free shipping once they reach the minimum order amount you set.
freeShippingThresholdDesc: The amount the order must reach for free shipping to apply. (Max 100,000 EGP)
freeShippingMessageDesc: Use {{amount}} to automatically display the minimum amount in the message.
freeShippingPreviewInactive: This message will be shown to customers when free shipping is enabled.
defaultFreeMessage: Get free shipping on orders of {{amount}} EGP or more
hideTopBarDesc: Hide the bar containing quick links (Start Order, Size Exchange within 14 days, Confirm Order before processing) from the top of the store.
flatShippingDesc: Choose whether shipping follows a flat rate for all orders or varies by region.
flatShippingEnabledDesc: When enabled, governorate and regional prices are ignored and the same price applies to all orders.
flatShippingFeeDesc: The price that will show as the same value for all customers on the checkout page. (Max 10,000 EGP)
flatShippingUseCase1: Suitable for stores with a fixed shipping cost regardless of governorate.
flatShippingUseCase2: If you need region-based pricing, keep it off and use detailed shipping settings.
resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset settings to default?
saveApplyDesc: Saving sends settings directly to the same API without any backend changes.
